commute_mode_mix.definition: Percentage mix among workers 16+ by five compact categories: drive, public transit, walk/bike, work from home, and other.
commute_mode_mix.source: U.S. Census Bureau American Community Survey
commute_mode_mix.table: B08301 Means of Transportation to Work

hud_subsidized_units.dedupe_rule: max subsidized units available per project code; prevents overlap across repeated program/sub-program rows
hud_subsidized_units.definition: Subsidized units available in HUD project-level public-housing and multifamily-assisted records spatially located inside the municipality.
hud_subsidized_units.semantic_limit: Project-level public housing and multifamily assisted units only; tenant-based vouchers without a project location are excluded.
hud_subsidized_units.source: U.S. HUD Picture of Subsidized Households
hud_subsidized_units.spatial_join: HUD project coordinates -> NJOGIS Municipal Boundaries MUN_CODE; unique project-code city fallback only when coordinates are missing.

low_income_cost_burden.definition: Share of owner- and renter-occupied households at or below 80% HAMFI with housing cost burden greater than 30%.
low_income_cost_burden.formula: 100 * (Table 8 >30%-50% burden + >50% burden counts across <=30%, >30-50%, >50-80% HAMFI; owners+renter) / (owner+renter household counts across the same <=80% HAMFI bands)
low_income_cost_burden.source: U.S. HUD Comprehensive Housing Affordability Strategy (CHAS)

municipal_boundaries.source: New Jersey Office of GIS Municipal Boundaries
